run_parlai_script_main: run a ParlAI script subclass using main with keyword args like task or model
run_superscript_main: run the ParlAI superscript to discover and execute all registered scripts from CLI
setup_script_registry: load and register all ParlAI scripts from parlai.scripts and optional internal packages
create_parlai_script_subclass: create a new ParlAI script by subclassing ParlaiScript and implementing setup_args and run
get_version_string: get the current ParlAI version string for display or logging purposes
